classification: Research claims reconciled to local source and saved receipts; no new throughput measured in this artifact.

local_corrections.claim: Static layer split with no expert cache; n_tokens==1 gate may disable it under DFlash.
local_corrections.observed: Custom GGML_OP_MOE_HYBRID adaptive expert cache supports tokens<=decode_max (default32), including 5-token DFlash verification.
local_corrections.profile_evidence: performance/budgeted-admission-profile-comparison.json; 19203 cache hits across 752 layer calls and 76 evaluated rows/layer.

local_corrections.claim: Expert buffers are pageable; NUMA and pinning absent.
local_corrections.observed: CUDA hybrid log reports 41.91GiB pinned expert RAM, launch uses --no-mmap, worker affinity has 15 successes/0 failures. Previously measured one visible NUMA node.

local_corrections.claim: No grouped CPU kernel; each verification pair re-reads weights.
local_corrections.observed: Grouped2-4-token IQ2_S/IQ3_S/IQ4_XS paths already reuse row unpacking; singleton uses standard GGML kernels. Q6_K uses the scalar-per-pair fallback.

local_corrections.claim: Quantized KV DFlash rotation fix is missing.
local_corrections.observed: DFlash K/V injection applies each cache Hadamard basis before writes, in both ISWA and non-ISWA paths.

local_corrections.claim: Draft is BF16 2.2GB at width15; prefill ubatch512.
local_corrections.observed: Corrected Q8_0 draft (~1129.96MiB GPU weights), q8_0 KV, DraftMax4, Batch/ubatch8192.

local_corrections.claim: DFlash necessarily slows this local engine 2-4x.
local_corrections.observed: Earlier local same-request no-draft runs measured 9.44/9.56 tok/s; early draft4 measured11.22, newest engine draft4 15.32. Builds differ, so these are not a controlled current comparison. One new same-build draft-on/off comparison is warranted.
12*131072*8*128*2*2=6GiB. q8_0 requires34/32bytes/element; current SWA cell count derives from window+8192 ubatch, not window+512.

local_corrections.claim: 5.1PFLOPs global attention divided by22TFLOPs establishes a hard prefill floor.
local_corrections.observed: 22TFLOPs is shader performance per NVIDIA; local CUDA flash attention uses MMA tensor cores. The full-square estimate also omits causal triangular savings. This calculation does not prove the target attainable or impossible.

local_corrections.claim: 0.26% worker overhead proves weight work is memory-bound and every fusion is capped at1.0026x.
local_corrections.observed: The measured0.26% only bounds worker phase/wakeup overhead. It does not distinguish weight dequantization from memory bandwidth. Paired kernel failures are retained separately.

derived_exact_quant_payload.limitation: Payload only. Cache hit rate, grouping, repeated reads, DMA, dequant cost and accepted speculative outputs determine real bytes/output and throughput.

derived_global_attention.limitation: Analytic arithmetic counts, not measured achieved kernel throughput; exclude other model work and kernel overhead.

selected_actions: Measure the already-built decode cache fit candidate against its flag0 control on identical binaries and saved8064-token request.
Make one current same-build DFlash on/off architectural comparison. No width, quantization, NUMA or thread sweep.
unchanged_constraints: Use saved performance_probe.py/request; no new tests
Stop only verified inference paths; no desktop app/driver/system changes
